## 6. Complete Project Inventory (33 Shipped Projects, 2015–2026)

### 1. PhotoLift (2026)
- **Category**: Native Desktop Software (Rust / Tauri)
- **Summary (EN)**: High-throughput desktop application for event and studio photo management. Automates session-based import, sorting, color grading, cropping, and batch compression—reducing JPEG file weight by ~88% (~1.16 MB to ~133 KB) with a 6-minute average per-client workflow.
- **Summary (FR)**: Application de bureau native (Rust + Tauri) pour la gestion et le traitement rapide de photos studio : import automatique, tri par séance, retouche colorimétrique et compression de 88 % (~6 min par client).
- **Technologies**: Tauri, React, Rust, Image Processing

### 2. Obvious Tool (2025)
- **Live URL**: https://obvioustool.com/
- **Category**: Live SaaS / AI & Developer Workspace (NLP / Local-First)
- **Summary (EN)**: Unified digital Swiss Army knife for developers and creatives (https://obvioustool.com) combining 50+ essential tools (converters, encoders, image/audio processors) with embedded AI modules for paraphrasing, grammar correction, and translation—running locally and ad-free for complete data privacy.
- **Summary (FR)**: Suite unifiée en ligne (https://obvioustool.com) réunissant plus de 50 outils essentiels pour développeurs et créatifs avec modules d'IA embarquée (paraphrase, correction, traduction), fonctionnant en local et sans publicité.
- **Technologies**: React, Desktop App, Embedded AI, Local-First Privacy

### 3. CVite (2025)
- **Category**: Applied NLP & Document AI
- **Summary (EN)**: AI-powered resume platform featuring automated NLP extraction from existing PDF/image resumes to populate structured profiles instantly, paired with a real-time typographic layout and template editor.
- **Summary (FR)**: Plateforme intelligente de création de CV propulsée par l'IA : extraction automatique depuis PDF/image et éditeur de mise en page en temps réel.
- **Technologies**: React, NLP, AI Integration, Vite

### 4. Smart Bucket (2025)
- **Category**: Machine Learning & Quantitative FinTech
- **Summary (EN)**: Autonomous crypto portfolio management engine driven by AI: dynamic multi-asset allocation and rebalancing across BTC, ETH, SOL, and TON, 24/7 market regime and sentiment monitoring, and executive performance telemetry.
- **Summary (FR)**: Système autonome de gestion de portefeuille crypto piloté par l'IA avec allocation dynamique, surveillance de marché et analyse de sentiment 24/7.
- **Technologies**: Python, Machine Learning, React, Quantitative Analytics

### 5. GhostLink (2024)
- **Category**: Zero-Knowledge Web Security
- **Summary (EN)**: Serverless cryptographic web app to share text, credentials, or files via an encrypted URL. Uses 100% client-side AES-256 encryption with zero server database storage—the link hash is the sole data carrier.
- **Summary (FR)**: Application web de partage de secrets chiffrée AES-256 entièrement côté client, sans aucun stockage serveur.
- **Technologies**: React, AES-256 Cryptography, Zero-Knowledge Web App
